Hi Alex / Kendra —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap + the items you asked for during the call so we can keep procurement moving: 

- SOC 2 status: Redwood has an active SOC 2 program. We completed a Type I in 2025 and expect Type II to be ready by 2027-03 (target). Attached is a short summary of in-scope services and control status.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows via our Private deployment and DPA. The HIPAA scoping notes are attached.
- Incident response / breach notification: We maintain an IR runbook and a documented breach-notification SLA that outlines 72-hour detection/assessment and 30-day closure timeline for major incidents. To avoid sharing full reports over email, we can grant time-limited access to a secure bucket with redacted post-mortems and the IR-runbook excerpt.
- Vendor security questionnaire: I’ve attached a copy of our standard SOC/controls summary, and happy to take the questionnaire you sent during the call. If it’s easier, we can also complete your spreadsheet directly — see next steps below.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Kendra — send over the vendor questionnaire you prefer we fill (spreadsheet or portal).
2) We’ll send temporary secure access to IR/BCP artifacts (redacted).
3) Ben will coordinate a technical deep-dive next week to walk through encryption/key management and network isolation in our Private deployment.
4) Marissa — I’ll loop you on procurement timeline and draft mutual NDA if Sandstone needs it before evidence sharing.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-hipaa-scope.txt

If that all sounds good, tell us which questionnaire format you prefer and we’ll get answers back within 3 business days for the initial pass.

Thanks,

Kendra — thanks for the clear ask. Answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

> 1) Can you confirm the exact date the Type I report was issued (for our vendor file)?
Type I was issued on 2025-11-09 (we can share the cover letter and management assertion).

> 2) For the IR runbook excerpt: do you have a redacted post-mortem from the last 18 months you can share (we are particularly looking for time-to-detection and time-to-notify metrics)?
We can share one redacted post-mortem that includes detection and notification timelines. It’s redacted for customer data but includes internal timestamps. I’ve attached an IR runbook excerpt and will provision the redacted post-mortem to the secure bucket link below (time-limited access). Expect the bucket link to include a README with what is redacted.

> 3) For HIPAA: is the Private deployment the only option for PHI, or are there contractual controls that allow Hosted API use with appropriate DPA terms?
Private deployment is the recommended path for PHI because it gives you control plane isolation and KMS integration (customer-managed keys). However, we do support Hosted API for HIPAA-covered workloads under a specific contractual addendum and with additional monitoring controls. We’ll include the relevant contractual language in the DPA addendum.

> 4) Do you have a standard data processing agreement and a DPA addendum to sign?
Yes — attached is our standard DPA addendum. If Sandstone legal prefers edits, we can run redlines; if you’d like speed, we can sign your draft DPA after a short review.

Shared artifacts (provisioning plan):
- Secure bucket (time-limited): https://secure-bucket.redwoodinference.com/sandstone-share/ (will provision by EOD)
- Attached: redwood-ir-runbook-excerpt.pdf
- Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (again)

Planned timeline: initial questionnaire answers back within 3 business days (by 2026-11-23), secure artifacts provisioned by EOD 2026-11-20, and technical deep-dive scheduled the week of 2026-11-23. If you need the post-mortem earlier, tell us and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks — Lauren
